items.quote: When Gaal and his men come out against you, seize the opportunity to attack them.
items.contrast: Attack Gaal and his men once they come out, rather than merely advance against the city.
items.reason: The window gives a sequence: Abimelek first advances against the city at sunrise, then attacks Gaal and his men when they come out. The question specifically asks what he should do at that later point.
